description: The threat model on the default branch has a row with no Code column: no questions, a note on the run (never a silent pass of the checks).

files.text:
# Threat model

## In scope

| ID | Threat | Control | Code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T1 | Forged webhook | Signature check with a constant-time compare | `src/webhook.ts` → `verifySignature` |
| T2 | Replayed delivery | Each delivery id is recorded once |

## Out of scope

- ARP spoofing: handled by the network layer.

## Operator contract

- `branch-protection-requires: PullUp` — Branch protection requires the PullUp check.

## Entry points

- `src/app/api/**/route.ts`, `fetch(`
